content: If the Service Discovery Module receives a StopSubscribeEventgroup E ntry , the following step(s) shall be performed in the following order: - Stop the TTL timer for this client - Update State - If this has been the last subscribed client, report “ SD_EVENT_HANDLER_RELEASED ” to the BswM by calling the API BswM_Sd_EventHandlerCurrentState () .

If the Service Discovery Module receives a StopSubscribeEvent- group Entry, the following step(s) shall be performed in the following order: • Stop the TTL timer for this client • Update State • If this has been the last subscribed client, report "SD_EVENT_HANDLER_RE- LEASED" to the BswM by calling the API BswM_Sd_EventHandlerCurrentState().
